title: keel brief metadata
description: The JSON companion of a compiled brief, .git/keel/briefs/BR-<sha12>.json (L7); the body is BR-<sha12>.md. The Steward compiles it deterministically per seat and subject from canonical documents and the proposal branch at the approved commit. Hashing uses LF-normalized, BOM-stripped, NFC bytes, and the runtime wrapper sits outside the hashed body.

subject.description: The proposal (product, architect, planner) or task (engineer, reviewer packet).

runtime.description: Runtime profile whose byte budget the brief was checked against.

body_sha256.description: sha256 of the normalized body; the id is BR- plus its first 12 hex characters.

write_set.description: The task's write_set, or null for seats that write no code.

forbidden.description: Forbidden paths: frozen tests, protected globs and .keel/**.

class.description: A change in a contract section (requirements, ACC, must and must_not obligations) makes a run stale_contract, which needs a re-ACK and re-review; a context change only adds an annotation.

sha256.description: sha256 of the normalized section body.

truncated.description: ACC and must and must_not obligations are never truncated.

sectionId.description: Brief sections, rendered through the single template templates/prompts/brief.md.tmpl.

ackIdKind.description: Id kinds in ACK id sets. Product: goal, requirement, invariant; planner: acceptance, requirement; engineer: acceptance, requirement, obligation (must and must_not); reviewer: packet.

ackId.description: A member of an ACK id set. Packet ids are the task id and the content ids of the packet items.

ackIdSet.description: The exact id set the seat's ACK must echo.
